text: This report requests City Council's authority to amend the Toronto Public Library 2019 Council Approved Capital Budget and 2020-2028 Capital Plan by adjusting cash flows contained within the 10-Year Capital Plan, respectively, to align forecasted project accelerations and deferrals. The adjustments will have a zero debt impact on the 2019 Capital Budget and 2020-2028 Capital Plan and will align the 2019 Capital Budget to Toronto Public Library's capital project delivery schedule and program requirements.
